title: Viva Insights: export de-identified agent metrics from the Agent Dashboard
summary: Hold: the policy-precedence explanation could lead administrators to believe a tenant-wide disable overrides an explicit user or group enable, whereas Microsoft documents the opposite. The briefing also overstates the absence of a documented export control identifier and makes an unsupported blanket statement about controls on downloaded files.
